contract_owner.role: read-only source, norm, and theorem-interface framing

exact_definitions: def observerNormSq (v : FourVector) : Real := ∑ i : Fin 4, (v i)^2
def observerNorm (v : FourVector) : Real := Real.sqrt (observerNormSq v)
def rateAmplitude (B : FourMatrix) : Real := Real.sqrt (frobeniusSq B)
def rateCap (epsilon0 R b2 b3 : Real) : Real := Real.sqrt (epsilon0^2 * Real.cosh (2 * R)^2 + b2^2 + b3^2)
exact_target_signatures: theorem epsilonSeq_le_initial (epsilon0 : Real) (he0 : 0 ≤ epsilon0) (n : Nat) : epsilonSeq epsilon0 n ≤ epsilon0
theorem observerNormSq_uChi (chi : Real) : observerNormSq (uChi chi) = Real.cosh (2 * chi)
theorem frobeniusSq_boostedB (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) : frobeniusSq (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3) = epsilon^2 * Real.cosh (2 * chi)^2 + b2^2 + b3^2
theorem observerNorm_pair_le (chi R : Real) (hchi : 0 ≤ chi) (hchiR : chi ≤ R) : observerNorm (uChi chi) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.cosh (2 * R)) ∧ observerNorm (uChi 0) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.cosh (2 * R))

theorem rateAmplitude_sequence_pair_le (epsilon0 chi R b2 b3 : Real) (he0 : 0 < epsilon0) (hchi : 0 ≤ chi) (hchiR : chi ≤ R) (n : Nat) : rateAmplitude (boostedB (epsilonSeq epsilon0 n) chi b2 b3) ≤ rateCap epsilon0 R b2 b3 ∧ rateAmplitude (boostedB (epsilonSeq epsilon0 n) 0 b2 b3) ≤ rateCap epsilon0 R b2 b3

semantic_contract.norm: Positive Euclidean component norm in one fixed observer tetrad; never a Lorentz contraction or invariant physical amplitude.
semantic_contract.rate_object: The actual covariant B tensors from the source family, bounded by their positive Frobenius component norm.
semantic_contract.rapidity: The two fixed rapidities chi and 0 lie in [0,R] under 0≤chi≤R; no arcosh reconstruction is introduced.
semantic_contract.formula: The exact squared rate amplitude includes both symmetric off-diagonal entries and equals epsilon^2*cosh(2 chi)^2+b2^2+b3^2.
semantic_contract.b2_b3: Positivity is not required for the norm bound; it remains a separate premise when composing kernel uniqueness.
